messages.subject: Pseudo-test cross
parts:
Hello,

Would you have some advice on what cross.type should I use to analyze data from a pseudo test cross?

thanks!

Best regards,
Cécile M.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Pseudo-test cross
parts:
Can you explain more precisely what you have in mind? Are you thinking of a cross between two outbred individuals, but just considering the markers that are heterozygous in one parent and homozygous in the other?

R/qtl2 doesn't currently include any facilities for the analysis of crosses between outbreds.

karl
